item.tinyrelics.keeping_charm.tooltip: Returns your whole inventory after death
item.tinyrelics.chaos_boomerang.tooltip: Right-click: throw through a chain of enemies
item.tinyrelics.blood_blade.tooltip2: Right-click at one heart: drain life from enemies
msg.tinyrelics.blade_health: The blade only awakens when you are down to one heart
msg.tinyrelics.no_permission: Only a server operator can change these settings
screen.tinyrelics.title: Tiny Relics: settings
screen.tinyrelics.craft.tip: Turn it off and this item's recipe disappears for every player. Items that already exist stay.
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_radius.tip: How many blocks in every direction from the player the lightning reaches. Default is 32.
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_fire.tip: When on, fire appears under every target. Off by default.
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_monsters.tip: Off: the hammer hits everyone. On: only hostile mobs, animals and players are safe.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.keeping_charm: Keep it in your inventory. When you die one charm breaks and all your items come back after you respawn. It does not keep experience.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.thor_hammer: Right-click: lightning strikes everything in range. Shift + right-click: throw, the hammer hits the first target and returns. Super ability key: jump 20 blocks up and slam the ground, sending out a ring of lightning.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.chaos_boomerang: Right-click: flies to the nearest enemy and jumps to the others like chain lightning, then returns. Shift + right-click: circles you for 20 seconds, knocks monsters back and blocks their hits. 10 second cooldown.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.blood_blade: Hit: 20% chance to cause bleeding. Right-click at one heart with enemies near: drains their life and heals you. Shift + right-click: a blood vortex heals players and pets within 8 blocks for 5 seconds and leaves you at 2 hearts. Each ability has a 2 minute cooldown.
item.tinyrelics.undead_staff.tooltip2: Shift + right-click: summon 2 skeletons and 3 zombies
item.tinyrelics.undead_staff.tooltip3: Key %s: blue fire once enough souls are gathered
screen.tinyrelics.staff_kills.tip: How many mobs you must kill to charge the blue fire. Default is 20.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.undead_staff: Right-click: wither skull, 1.5 second cooldown. Shift + right-click: 2 skeletons and 3 zombies for a minute, they attack whoever hits you; 2 minute cooldown. Kill mobs with the staff in your inventory, then press the fire key: blue fire erupts in a 30×30 area around you.
screen.tinyrelics.staff_grief.tip: Off: the wither skull explodes but leaves blocks alone. On: it breaks them like a real wither's skull.
item.tinyrelics.blood_blade.tooltip3: Shift + right-click: a blood vortex heals allies at the cost of your health
msg.tinyrelics.blade_vortex_health: The blood vortex needs more than two hearts
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_slam_radius.tip: How far the landing after the jump reaches. Default is 10.
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_slam_fire.tip: On: the sky strike sets everyone in range on fire. Off: damage only.
item.tinyrelics.necro_armor.tooltip: Full set: what you kill rises as your servant
screen.tinyrelics.desc.necro_armor: Helmet 2, chestplate 5, leggings 3, boots 1. With all four pieces on, every mob or player you kill rises where it died as a zombie or a skeleton and fights for you for 30 seconds. No more than 5 such servants at once.
msg.tinyrelics.vanish_wait: Vanishing will be ready in %s s
screen.tinyrelics.desc.chaos_armor: Hood 3, chestplate 6, leggings 3, boots 1. The full set gives Speed III. Key I: the wearer vanishes in a cloud of steam, armor and weapon included, mobs lose track, and Speed V is granted. Cooldown 2 minutes.
screen.tinyrelics.vanish_seconds.tip: How many seconds the vanishing and Speed V last. 10 by default.
item.tinyrelics.blood_armor.tooltip2: Only the blood of peaceful animals refills them
msg.tinyrelics.rain_wait: Blood rain will be ready in %s s
screen.tinyrelics.desc.blood_armor: Crown 4, chestplate 7, leggings 5, boots 2. The full set gives 4 blood hearts: each peaceful animal killed returns one. Key I: blood rain. Crafted from blood ingots, which the blood altar makes.
screen.tinyrelics.rain_cooldown.tip: Seconds between two blood rains. 180 by default.
screen.tinyrelics.rain_radius.tip: How far the rain reaches from its centre. 4 is nine blocks across. 4 by default.
